certificateGuide.title: Install Capture Certificate
certificateGuide.description: To identify media and other resources over HTTPS, this computer must trust the root certificate generated only for this device. Its private key stays on this computer.
certificateGuide.system_authorization_tip: Windows User Account Control (UAC) will appear after you click Install. This one-time authorization only adds this device certificate to the system trust store; the rest of the app continues with standard privileges.
certificateGuide.password_authorization_tip: Installing the certificate requires administrator authorization for this computer. The password is used only for this operation and is not saved.
certificateGuide.password_tip: The password is never written to settings, logs, or other persistent files.
certificateGuide.install_failed: Certificate installation failed. Check system authorization and try again.
certificateGuide.cleanup_description: A shared root certificate from an earlier app version was detected. Remove it from this computer's system trust store so the retired certificate is no longer trusted.
certificateGuide.cleanup_windows_tip: Windows User Account Control (UAC) will appear after you click Remove. This authorization is used only to delete the legacy certificate.
certificateGuide.cleanup_failed: Legacy certificate cleanup failed. Check system authorization and try again.

index.certificate_required: Install the current device certificate in Settings before starting capture.
index.remember_clear_choice: Remember this selection and clear it next time
index.resource_count_warning: There are {count} captured resources, including collection items. This may increase memory usage and affect stability. Consider clearing resources you no longer need.
index.preview_unsupported: This system cannot play this streaming format
index.download_no_tip: This type of download is not supported yet. Please copy the link and use other tools to download.
index.plugin_action_request_failed: The action request failed. Check the app connection and try again.
index.import_placeholder: When adding multiple items, ensure each line contains only one (each link on a new line)
index.win_install_tip: Windows did not grant permission to install the certificate. If no authorization prompt appeared, close the app, reopen it with 'Run as administrator', and install the certificate again.
index.download_queued: has been added to the queue, current queue length：{count}
index.start_err_content: The current startup process has encountered an issue. Do you want to reset the application?
index.reset_app_tip:
This will uninstall the capture certificate from this computer and delete app settings, captured resources, task history, operation history and results, capture cache, and download temporary files in the current save directory.

Downloaded files, installed plugins, and temporary files in other save directories are kept.

Clear cache and restart?
index.reset_app_authorize_tip: Administrator access is required to remove the current and legacy certificates. The password is used only for this operation and is not saved.
index.reset_app_failed: Cleanup failed and the app was not reset: {message}

tasks.title: Downloads
tasks.description: Manage download progress and history. Clearing captured resources does not affect these tasks.
tasks.batch_cancel_confirm: Cancel the selected {count} regular download tasks?
tasks.batch_delete_confirm: Delete the selected {count} task records? Downloaded files will not be removed.
tasks.recording_batch_tip: Live recordings are excluded from batch cancellation. Use Stop and Save on the task instead.
tasks.clear_finished_confirm: Clear completed, failed, cancelled, and interrupted task records? Downloaded files will not be removed.
tasks.delete_confirm: Delete this task record? Downloaded files will not be removed.

setting.restart_tip: Keep default if unsure, please restart software after modification
setting.save_dir_absolute_error: Select a folder with an absolute path
setting.save_dir_missing_error: The selected folder does not exist or is not a folder
setting.filename_template_tip: Name downloaded files using the resource title, author, date, and other details. Use / to create subdirectories. Leave blank to use the default template.
setting.filename_template_unclosed_error: A variable is missing its closing {'}}'}
setting.filename_template_truncate_error: The truncate limit must be an integer from 1 to 1000
setting.filename_template_relative_error: The template must produce a path inside the save directory
setting.filename_template_parent_error: The template cannot contain a parent directory segment (..)
setting.filename_template_empty_path_error: The template must produce a nonempty path
setting.insert_tail_tip: When enabled, newly captured resources appear at the end of the list. Otherwise, they appear at the top.
setting.upstream_proxy_tip: For combining with other proxy tools, format: http://username:password{'@'}your.proxy.server:port
setting.upstream_proxy_required_error: Enter an upstream proxy address before enabling proxy use
setting.upstream_proxy_format_error: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS proxy URL; ports must be from 1 to 65535
setting.download_proxy_tip: Use the upstream proxy for downloads and update checks
setting.connections_tip: Keep default if unsure, usually CPU cores * 2, for faster downloads
setting.use_headers_tip: Enter the names of request headers to include in downloads, separated by commas. Use default to let the app filter them automatically.
setting.media_path_absolute_error: Enter the full executable path, or leave it empty for automatic detection
setting.media_path_missing_error: The path does not point to an existing file; choose the executable again
setting.capture_rules_tip: These rules identify common resources and are matched from highest to lowest priority. Use dedicated plugins for complex sites. The MIME, URL, and Content-Disposition groups must all match; within each group, any matching value is sufficient. The * wildcard is supported.
setting.capture_rule_details: Edit match conditions and resource output
setting.capture_rule_order_tip: Rules match by descending priority; equal priorities retain their current order
setting.interception_policies_tip: Choose whether to decrypt HTTPS traffic by domain. If several policies match a domain, the last matching policy in the list takes effect. Use Generic Resource Rules to filter resources.
setting.port_format_error: The port must be an integer from 1025 to 65534
setting.host_format_error: Enter a valid IP address or hostname
setting.open_log_directory_failed: Unable to open the log folder: {message}
setting.media_engine_tip: FFmpeg is not bundled. Leave paths empty to detect it from PATH, or enter full paths to your own FFmpeg and FFprobe installation. Plugins can then use controlled muxing, remuxing, HLS downloading, and live recording.
setting.media_install_website: Install FFmpeg from the official website
setting.certificate_device_tip: A unique MITM root certificate and private key are generated on first launch. The private key stays on this device and is no longer embedded in the app.
setting.certificate_phone_tip: If your phone has the legacy shared certificate, remove it manually in the phone's settings, then download and install this computer's current certificate. The desktop app cannot remove phone certificates for you. Routine upgrades do not require reinstallation.
setting.certificate_uninstall_confirm: This computer will stop trusting the capture proxy, and the app-managed system proxy will be disabled. Continue? The local certificate and private key will be kept.
setting.certificate_uninstall_success: The current device certificate was removed from the system trust store
setting.certificate_uninstall_authorize_tip: Administrator access is required to remove this device certificate from the system trust store. The password is used only for this removal and is not saved; the local certificate and private key are retained.
setting.certificate_install_success: The current device certificate was installed in the system trust store
setting.certificate_install_authorize_tip: Administrator access is required to install this device's root certificate in the system trust store. The password is used only for this installation and is not saved.
setting.certificate_cleanup_authorize_tip: The legacy certificate is in the macOS/Linux system trust store. Enter this computer's administrator password. It is used only for this cleanup and is not saved.

plugin.store_stale: The store is offline. Showing the last successfully cached index
plugin.local_match_same_version: This ZIP has the same plugin ID and version as the store entry, but its file contents are not guaranteed to be identical.

update.check_network_failed: Could not retrieve version information. Check your connection and download proxy settings, then try again.
update.up_to_date: You’re up to date. No update is needed.
update.title: An update is available

operations.title: Plugin operations
operations.subtitle: Use a connected page to run operations and review results and history.
operations.search: Search names, plugins or operation IDs
operations.no_operations: No operations. Enable a plugin that provides operations.
operations.plugin_automation: Allow CLI / MCP access to this plugin
operations.operation_automation: Expose this operation to CLI / MCP
operations.automation_hint: Disabling the plugin switch blocks all its operations from automation. Desktop calls remain available.
operations.resource_context: Resource context: {id}. The host reads and validates the resource action parameters.
operations.retry_hint: Retry of {id}: enter the complete parameters again; history summaries may omit inputs.
operations.no_pages: No matching page. Enable the proxy and open a website supported by this plugin.
operations.multiple_pages: Multiple pages match. Select the target for this call.
operations.readiness_hint: The page is disconnected, not ready, or login is unconfirmed. Prepare the website and refresh.
operations.batch_hint: Each item runs independently; maximum {limit} items. Items share the selected page, cursor and item limit. Pages are not fetched automatically.
operations.idempotency: Idempotency key (optional; identical calls reuse execution)
operations.choose_operation: Select an operation to view its parameters and target pages.
operations.retention_hint: Summaries default to 7 days and results to 2 hours; adjust these periods below. Plugins may use shorter retention or memory-only results. Count and storage limits may trigger earlier cleanup.
operations.clean_hint: Cleanup affects operation records, results and artifact references. Resources, downloads and completed files remain. Records are retained while execution or result processing continues, or until the page confirms it has stopped.
operations.clean_results_confirm: Clear results and artifact references for finished operations whose underlying work has stopped?
operations.clean_history_confirm: Clear history, results and artifact references for finished operations whose underlying work has stopped? Unexpired idempotency protection remains.
operations.batch_result_hint: Items follow input order. Failures do not discard successful results. Open a failed item to re-enter its input and retry when safe. Cancellation does not cancel independent downloads.
operations.uncertain: Effects may have occurred without a confirmed result. Check the website and downloads before submitting again.
operations.interrupted_hint: Execution was interrupted and will not be replayed automatically. Review the page and existing results.
operations.cancel_confirmed: The page confirmed cancellation. Website requests and independent downloads are not automatically undone.
operations.cancel_requested: Cancellation was requested but has not been confirmed by the page. Sent website requests may still take effect.
operations.summary_hint: Only fields allowed for persistence are shown. Do not infer the full request or credentials from this summary.
operations.projection_hint: This persisted result contains only fields permitted for retention and may differ from the original result.
operations.next_page_hint: Next-page cursor is filled. Review the original query inputs and target page before submitting.
operations.invalid_json: Enter valid JSON: an object for a single call, or an array of up to 32 objects for a batch.
operations.submitted: Submitted. Progress is available in history.
operations.connection_error: Cannot reach the operation service. Refresh and try again.
operations.sync_unavailable: Status is temporarily unavailable. The last known state is shown; this does not imply execution failure.

errors.storage_unavailable: Operation storage is unavailable. Executions cannot be reliably saved or recovered. Check the application storage and logs.
errors.page_ambiguous: Multiple pages match. Select a target page.
errors.page_unavailable: The target page is unavailable. Keep resource capture enabled, refresh the corresponding browser page, then retry once its content loads. Refresh the page after restarting the app or reloading the plugin as well.
errors.page_disconnected: The target browser page is not connected. Keep resource capture enabled and refresh that page. Refresh it after restarting the app or reloading the plugin as well.
errors.page_not_ready: The target browser page is connected, but its content is not ready. Wait for the content to load, then retry.
errors.page_login_required: This operation requires login, but the target page has not confirmed it. Sign in on the corresponding browser page, wait for its content to load, then retry.
errors.automation_disabled: Automation access is disabled for this operation.
errors.invalid_input: Input does not meet the operation contract. Check the JSON and parameter schema.
errors.invalid_batch: The batch is invalid or exceeds host limits and was not submitted.
errors.invalid_resource: The resource context is invalid or does not belong to this plugin operation.
errors.queue_full: The execution queue is full. Submit later.
errors.idempotency_conflict: This idempotency key was used with different parameters. Check the inputs or choose a new key.
errors.retry_unsafe: This execution cannot be safely retried. Check existing effects first.
errors.not_cancellable: This operation does not support cancellation.
errors.not_found: The record or operation was not found; it may have been cleaned or disabled.
errors.operation_unavailable: The plugin operation is unavailable. Check whether the plugin is enabled.
errors.artifact_unavailable: The artifact is expired, missing, or unavailable.
errors.text_too_large: Text exceeds the 1 MiB read limit. View the downloaded file.
errors.not_text: This artifact is not a supported text type.
errors.cursor_expired: The cursor expired or does not match the current query or page.
errors.history_full: Execution history is full. Clear history first.
errors.input_too_large: Input exceeds the host size limit.
errors.output_too_large: The plugin result exceeds the host size limit.
errors.invalid_output: The plugin result failed output schema validation.
errors.host_restarted: The application restarted. Execution was interrupted and will not be replayed.
errors.host_stopped: The application stopped and interrupted execution.
errors.page_or_plugin_changed: The page, account state or plugin changed. Execution was interrupted.
errors.queue_timeout: Queue wait exceeded the deadline. Execution did not start.
errors.execution_timeout: Acceptance, heartbeat or execution exceeded its deadline. Check the page for effects.
errors.page_delivery_failed: The operation could not be delivered to the target page.
errors.cancel_unconfirmed: Cancellation is not confirmed by the page. Check what has already occurred.
errors.page_execution_failed: Page execution failed. Check the page state and plugin requirements.
errors.invalid_pagination: The plugin returned invalid pagination information.
errors.result_processing_failed: Result processing or resource/download registration failed.
errors.cursor_limit: The pagination cursor capacity was reached.
errors.invalid_range: The requested text range exceeds the allowed limit.
errors.invalid_offset: The text offset is not a UTF-8 character boundary.
errors.invalid_utf8: The artifact is not valid UTF-8 text.
errors.execution_unavailable: The execution record was cleaned, but its idempotency protection remains active. Review history and existing effects.
errors.page_busy_unknown: The previous execution timed out or was interrupted, but the page has not confirmed it stopped. New operations on this page are temporarily blocked. Wait for acknowledgement, or refresh the website and select its new session.
errors.service_stopping: The operation service is stopping. Query execution status after the application restarts.

operations.cleaned_hint: Detailed results and artifact references have been cleared. If an idempotency key was used, the original execution summary remains queryable until the key expires, and repeating the same call will not run it again.
